g.text: (c) MF on the same probe states
Offline pose interpolation with fixed covariance; not a solver run. Panels (b,c): seed 6, cycles 94–95.
Native SF and MF units differ. Panel (a) covers detected boundaries in s = 0.6–1.2 m, successful SF trials only.
